comment: Per-model capability manifest for the direct sora adapter. Every value is READ OUT OF THE TREE and cited in input_notes. Both entries are concrete model ids the adapter names (adapters/sora.sh:20,73-74); sora-2 is the adapter default (:111) and the XML <default-model> (agents/templates/.ai-video.xml.example:101). verified stays false: the adapter header records a live 1/1 round-trip on sora-2 (adapters/sora.sh:9-13) but names no trace id reachable from the tree, and sora-2-pro has never been rendered here at all.

sora-2.label: OpenAI Sora 2 (text-to-video, native audio)
sora-2.input_notes: model id from adapters/sora.sh:20,74 and agents/templates/.ai-video.xml.example:101; seconds enum {'4','8','12'} verified empirically via validation-error probes with no spend (:12,:15-16,:21) and is the clamp the adapter applies (:114-119); audio_sync true from the declared audio=native (:4) and the fixture's audio_embedded:true (media/lib/fixtures/sora/result.json); aspect is the adapter's own two-branch size mapping — 9:16 to 720x1280, everything else to 1280x720 (:121-122) — out of the verified size enum {720x1280,1280x720,1024x1792,1792x1024} (:12,:22); cost_per_second_usd from _sora_model_rate_usd_per_s sora-2* = 0.10 (:74), corroborated by the header's ~$0.40 for a 4 s render (:11)

sora-2-pro.label: OpenAI Sora 2 Pro (text-to-video, native audio)
sora-2-pro.input_notes: model id from adapters/sora.sh:20,73; seconds and size enums are the same adapter-level surface as sora-2 (:114-122) — the adapter branches on the model only for the rate; audio_sync true from the declared audio=native (:4); cost_per_second_usd from _sora_model_rate_usd_per_s sora-2-pro* = 0.30 (:73); NEVER rendered from this repo — no live round-trip is recorded for this id anywhere in the tree
